ai.usingKnowledgeBase: Kusetyenziswa isiseko solwazi esakhelwe ngaphakathi de i-AI isetwe.
notFound.title: Iphepha alifumanekanga
error.notPlant: Le foto ayibonisi isityalo, ngoko ke ayihlalutywanga. Thatha ifoto ekufutshane, ekhanyayo yamagqabi, isiqu okanye iziqhamo zesityalo uze uzame kwakhona.
error.tooMany: Izicelo ezininzi kakhulu. Nceda ulinde kancinci uze uzame kwakhona.
error.network: Ayikwazi ukufikelela iseva ye-Crop Advisor. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwakho lwe-intanethi uze uzame kwakhona.
error.photoType: Nceda ukhethe ifoto (JPEG, PNG okanye WebP).
home.scanText: Thatha ifoto okanye uyibeke apha. I-AI ijonga impilo yaso, iingxaki, inqanaba lokukhula, iimfuno zesichumisi kunye nokulungela ukuvunwa.
home.notesPlaceholder: umz. Amagqabi amthubi aneesangqa ezimdaka kumasebe asezantsi emva kweveki yemvula
home.recentEmpty: Uhlalutyo lwezityalo zakho luya kubonakala apha.
home.photoTip: Icebiso lefoto: thatha ifoto emini, gcwalisa ifoto ngamagqabi okanye iziqhamo ezichaphazelekayo, uze wongeze inkcazo emfutshane yoko ukubonayo.
analysis.expertTitle: Qinisekisa nengcali phambi kokuba utshize okanye uthenge nantoni na
analysis.expertNote: Bonisa le ngxelo kwigosa lakho lezolimo lasekuhlaleni okanye kwisazi sezolimo. Sebenzisa iqhosha lokuprinta ukuyigcina njenge-PDF.
expert.severe: Kufunyenwe ingxaki enkulu enokusasazeka okanye ibangele ilahleko enkulu.
expert.unsure_crop: I-AI ayiqinisekanga ukuba sesiphi isityalo esi, ngoko iingcebiso zisenokungafaneli.
expert.offline: Olu luqikelelo olusekelwe kumbala wegqabi kuphela; imodeli ye-AI ibingafumaneki.
analysis.noIssues: Akukho zifo, zinambuzane okanye ukunqongophala okufunyenweyo. Qhubeka nomsebenzi omhle!
analysis.treatmentIntro: Ngokusekelwe kwingxaki efunyenweyo, nasi isikhokelo sokukunceda unyange isityalo sakho:
analysis.noTreatment: Isityalo sakho sibonakala sisempilweni — akufuneki nyango. Landela iingcebiso zokuthintela ukuze sihlale sinjalo.
analysis.safety: Sebenzisa kuphela iimveliso zokukhusela izityalo ezibhalisiweyo zesityalo sakho kwilizwe lakho. Landela ileyibhile, nxiba iimpahla zokuzikhusela kwaye uhlonele ixesha lokulinda phambi kokuvuna. Qinisekisa iimeko ezinzima negosa lakho lezolimo lasekuhlaleni.
analysis.disclaimer: Iingcebiso ze-AI ziyaxhasa, kodwa azithathi indawo, yeengcebiso zegosa lakho lezolimo lasekuhlaleni.
chat.welcome: Molo! Ndingumncedisi wakho we-Crop Advisor AI. Ndingakunceda ekuchongeni izifo zezityalo, ekulawuleni izondlo, kwiingcebiso zokunkcenkceshela nakwiingcebiso zokukhathalela izityalo. Ndingakunceda ngantoni namhlanje?
chat.title: Umncedisi we-Crop Advisor AI
chat.ex1: Kutheni amagqabi etumato yam esiba mthubi?
chat.ex3: Ndingenza ntoni ngala machaphaza akumagqabi am?
chat.ex4: Ngaba iitumato zam sele zilungele ukuvunwa?
chat.photoQuestion: Nceda ujonge le foto yesityalo sam. Ubona ntoni kwaye kufuneka ndenze ntoni?
chat.scanContext: Umncedisi usebenzisa uxilongo lolu skeno xa ephendula.
chat.photoAttached: Ifoto incanyathiselwe — buza umbuzo okanye uthumele nje.
list.favoritesHint: Cofa inkwenkwezi kulo naluphi na uhlalutyo ukuze ulugcine apha.
list.historyHint: Skena isityalo ukuze ufumane ingxelo yakho yokuqala yempilo.
guides.tellMore: Ndixelele ngakumbi nge: {title}. Kufuneka ndenze ntoni kwifama yam?
analytics.noDataText: Hlalutya izityalo ezimbalwa kwaye iindlela zempilo yefama yakho ziya kubonakala apha.
analytics.hoverTip: Beka imawusi okanye ucofe ibha ukuze ubone uskeno
analytics.noProblemsYet: Akukho ngxaki ifunyenweyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku.
fert.askQuestion: Sesiphi isichumisi ekufuneka ndisisebenzisile kwi-{crop} yam kwinqanaba le-{stage}, kwaye kangakanani ngesityalo ngasinye okanye ngemitha nganye yesikwere?
auth.tagline: Thatha ifoto yesityalo uze ufumane uxilongo nesicwangciso sonyango ngolwimi lwakho.
auth.name: Igama lakho
auth.tooShort: Sebenzisa ubuncinci boonobumba aba-8 kwiphasiwedi yakho.
auth.wrong: Inombolo yefowuni, i-imeyile okanye iphasiwedi engachanekanga.
auth.exists: Sele ikhona iakhawunti enale nombolo yefowuni okanye i-imeyile. Ngena endaweni yoko.
auth.badIdentifier: Faka inombolo yefowuni esebenzayo (umzekelo 082 123 4567) okanye idilesi ye-imeyile.
camera.title: Thatha umfanekiso
camera.denied: Ikhamera ivaliwe. Cofa umfanekiso wekhamera kwibha yedilesi, ukhethe Vumela, uze uzame kwakhona. (Ibhrawuza eyakhelwe ngaphakathi ye-VS Code ayinakusebenzisa ikhamera: vula isayithi kwi-Chrome okanye kwi-Edge.)
camera.busy: Ikhamera isetyenziswa enye inkqubo. Yivale uze uzame kwakhona.
camera.insecure: Ikhamera isebenza kuphela xa isayithi ivulwe kwi-http://localhost:8080 okanye nge-https. Yivule ngolo hlobo, okanye ukhethe umfanekiso endaweni yoko.
